title: Suitcase Carry
summary: A one-hand carry that makes your trunk resist leaning, for the obliques, grip and traps.

muscles.why: Library rating 0.9 for forearms (main mover): each working set adds 0.9 of a set to the weekly forearms total.
Library rating 0.8 for obliques (main mover): each working set adds 0.8 of a set to the weekly obliques total.
Library rating 0.6 for traps (helper): each working set adds 0.6 of a set to the weekly traps total.
Library rating 0.3 for abs (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly abs total.
Library rating 0.2 for abductors: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly abductors total.

setup.text: Pick up a heavy bell in one hand.
Walk tall for a set distance without leaning.

form_cues.cue: Stand as if you were carrying nothing.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds up to 2 ramp-up sets only when the load is heavy for the equipment and the main muscle is not warm yet.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 7.5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 8-12 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.
